excerpt_i18n.en: In the past period, the most impressive AI-generated videos often lasted only a few seconds. With natural character states, well-crafted lighting and atmosphere, and sufficiently smooth movements, it was easy to feel that video generation was close to being truly usable. However, as the industry advances, the problems become clearer. The real challenge has never been creating a short, beautiful clip, but maintaining that quality consistently over time. Once the video length is extended, many models begin to gradually destabilize—characters, scenes, and actions may appear to continue, but internal detail drift and temporal looseness emerge. This is why the current bottleneck in the AI video industry is no longer just about generating clips, but about generating continuous, stable content that can sustain a complete context. For example, in a kitchen video, as the camera moves from prepping ingredients to cooking and then to plating, viewers expect the same space, the same set of utensils, and the same ingredients to be naturally connected. Similarly, in a city commute video, as a character walks from a subway exit to a street-side shop, the camera may change, but the character's state, environmental relationships, and action logic must not drift apart. Only by solving this long-term stability issue can AI video truly transition from demonstration to creation and production. It is against this backdrop that Zhang Chi's team at Westlake University proposed "Free-Lunch Long Video Generation via Layer-Adaptive O.O.D Correction."
excerpt_i18n.es: Durante un tiempo, lo más impresionante de los videos generados por IA solían ser los primeros segundos. El estado de los personajes era natural, la iluminación y el ambiente estaban bien logrados, y los movimientos eran lo suficientemente fluidos, lo que fácilmente daba la sensación de que la generación de video estaba cerca de ser realmente utilizable. Pero cuanto más avanza la industria, más claros se vuelven los problemas: lo realmente difícil nunca ha sido crear un fragmento visual bonito, sino mantener esa calidad de manera estable a lo largo del tiempo. Una vez que se alarga la duración del video, muchos modelos comienzan a perder estabilidad gradualmente: los personajes, las escenas y los movimientos parecen continuar en la superficie, pero internamente ya aparecen desviaciones en los detalles y una pérdida de coherencia temporal. Por eso, hoy en día, el verdadero cuello de botella en la industria del video con IA ya no es solo si se puede generar.

items.raw_excerpt: 过去两年，视频生成的发展几乎是指数级的。从最早只能生成模糊片段，到如今可以生成具有叙事结构、光影一致性甚至风格控制的长视频，行业表面上已经接近一个阶段性成熟。 但如果把评价标准从“能不能生成一段视频”稍微提高到“能不能控制镜头”，问题就会完全暴露出来。当前大多数模型仍然停留在一种近似二维的生成范式中，它们擅长在时间上延续视觉模式，却缺乏对空间结构的稳定建模能力。 一旦涉及视角变化，模型往往无法保证同一个物体在不同帧之间的几何一致性，人物会发生细微但累积的漂移，建筑结构在移动中逐渐扭曲，遮挡关系也难以维持连续，这意味着模型生成的并不是一个被持续观察的世界，而是一系列在视觉上相似但空间上不一致的结果。 在这样的行业背景下，西湖大学 AGI Lab 研究团队提出了论文《Taming Video Models for 3D and 4D Generation via Zero Shot Camera Control》，值得一提的是，这篇论文也入选了 CVPR Highlight。与以往通过重新训练模型来引入控制能力的路径不同，这项工作将问题重新落回到推理阶段本身，尝试在不改变模型参数的情况下，让相机轨迹成为生成过程中的约束条件，使模型在每一步生成中持续对齐同一个空间结构。 换句话说，这项研究关注的不是如何让模型生成更多内容，而是如何让模型在视角变化中保持世界的一致性，从而把视频生成从二维视觉合成，推进到具有三维结构约束的动态世界建模。 如果从应用角度理解这一点，可以把它看成一种能力的转变。过去模型更像一个能够不断画出新画面的系统，而现在的目标，是让模型像一个可以移动的摄影机，在同一个场景中进行观察和记录。无论是商品展示、空间漫游，还是内容创作中的镜头设计，本质上都依赖这种能力的成立。 WorldForge 的提出，正是在这一关键转折点上，给出了一个不依赖额外训练、却能够实现精确相机

excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past two years, video generation has advanced at an almost exponential pace. From producing only blurry clips initially to now generating long videos with narrative structure, lighting consistency, and even style control, the industry appears to have reached a stage of relative maturity. However, if the evaluation criterion shifts from "whether a video can be generated" to "whether camera movement can be controlled," the issues become fully apparent. Most current models remain stuck in a quasi-2D generation paradigm—they excel at extending visual patterns over time but lack stable modeling of spatial structures. When perspective changes occur, these models often fail to maintain geometric consistency of the same object across frames: characters experience subtle but cumulative drift, architectural structures gradually distort during movement, and occlusion relationships struggle to remain continuous. This means the model does not generate a consistently observed world, but rather a series of visually similar yet spatially inconsistent results. Against this industry backdrop, the AGI Lab research team at Westlake University proposed the paper "Taming Video Models for 3D and 4D Generation via Zero Shot Camera Control," which notably was selected as a CVPR Highlight. Unlike previous approaches that introduced control capabilities by retraining models, this work reframes the problem at the inference stage itself, attempting to achieve camera control without altering model parameters.
excerpt_i18n.es: En los últimos dos años, el desarrollo de la generación de video ha sido casi exponencial. Desde los primeros fragmentos borrosos hasta la capacidad actual de generar videos largos con estructura narrativa, coherencia de iluminación e incluso control de estilo, la industria parece haber alcanzado una madurez parcial. Sin embargo, si elevamos el criterio de evaluación de "poder generar un video" a "poder controlar la cámara", el problema queda completamente expuesto. La mayoría de los modelos actuales siguen atrapados en un paradigma de generación casi bidimensional: son hábiles para prolongar patrones visuales en el tiempo, pero carecen de una capacidad estable para modelar estructuras espaciales. items.raw_excerpt: 2026年4月19日，第二届北京亦庄人形机器人半程马拉松赛事圆满落幕。多台搭载进迭时空 RISC－V AI CPU K3 芯片的「灵龙 2.0」人形机器人顺利完赛。「灵龙 2.0」是上海国家地方共建人形机器人创新中心开发的人形机器人平台。 在长距离、高负载、强实时的极限场景中，K3 经受住了实战验证。面对人形机器人运动控制对芯片“算力、响应、功耗、通信”高度耦合的系统级严苛要求：既要保障AI推理的高吞吐算力，又要满足伺服控制的瞬间响应，还需在长续航下守住功耗红线、在多传感器并行时压缩传输延迟。K3 从芯片微架构层面给出了一体化解答，标志着 RISC－V 芯片方案已具备支撑高动态、复杂环境人形机器人竞技的成熟工程能力。   架构优势：为人形机器人而生的芯片微架构 传统“CPU＋MCU＋NPU”多芯片分立架构，各功能域依赖外部总线桥接，跨芯片通信延迟存在高度不确定性。在 500Hz＋ 高频伺服场景下，这种微秒级抖动成为难以逾越的系统性瓶颈。K3 则从芯片微架构层面给出了一体化解答：   K3 芯片一体化架构示意图 ▲ 3MB TCM，打破推理“内存墙”。RL 策略权重完整驻留片上，消除 DDR 访问延迟长尾，实测推理延迟降低约 60％，P99 与 P50 几乎持平； ▲ 1024 位超宽向量引擎，弥合 Sim2Real 时序鸿沟单指令并行处理 128 个 INT8 数据，保障多模态＋数据时间戳严格对齐； ▲ 双域共享中断与双套控制寄存器共存，实现实时域与算力域的并行自治。实时域以微秒级延迟完成电机指令下发，算力域同步刷新推理流水线，两域按各自时钟独立调度，互不拖累，500Hz通信周期抖动稳定在个位数微秒量级； ▲统一内存架构，实现三域共享内存与域间互相保活。通用域、算力域、实时域共享同一物理内存，零拷贝数据流转，端到端延迟趋近于单次内存访问。 架构

On April 19, 2026, the second Beijing Yizhuang Humanoid Robot Half Marathon concluded successfully. Multiple "Linglong 2.0" humanoid robots equipped with the SpacemiT RISC-V AI CPU K3 chip completed the race. The "Linglong 2.0" is a humanoid robot platform developed by the Shanghai National and Local Co-built Humanoid Robot Innovation Center. In extreme scenarios involving long distances, high loads, and strong real-time demands, the K3 chip proved its capabilities through practical validation. Addressing the highly coupled system-level requirements of humanoid robot motion control—such as high-throughput AI inference, instant servo control response, power consumption constraints for extended endurance, and minimized transmission latency with multi-sensor parallelism—the K3 chip provides an integrated solution at the microarchitecture level. This marks that the RISC-V chip solution has achieved mature engineering capabilities to support high-dynamic, complex-environment humanoid robot competitions.

Architecture Advantage: Chip Microarchitecture Designed for Humanoid Robots  
Traditional multi-chip architectures like "CPU + MCU + NPU" rely on external bus bridges for inter-chip communication, leading to high latency uncertainty. In high-frequency servo scenarios exceeding 500Hz, microsecond-level jitter becomes an insurmountable systemic bottleneck. The K3 chip offers an integrated solution at the microarchitecture level:

Leiphone.com exclusively learned that former Huawei "Genius Youth" and Level 19 technical expert Zhao Lichen left the company in March 2026 to join Hangzhou Lagrange Embodied Technology Co., Ltd. Lagrange pursues a differentiated path from other embodied intelligence companies, focusing on the development of an embodied intelligence architecture (Agentic OS) and large-scale hardware deployment, aiming to establish an advantage in the most critical and challenging layer of embodied intelligence.  

01 Who is Zhao Lichen?  
According to public information, Zhao Lichen earned both his bachelor's and master's degrees in Software Engineering from Beihang University, with a long-term focus on 3D vision and multimodality. His related work has been cited over a thousand times, making him the only student from Beihang University selected for Huawei's "Genius Youth" program.  
During his undergraduate studies, he won the gold medal in the ACM-ICPC East Asia Regional Finals twice. In 2021, he participated in the pre-training of the INTERN 20B large model at SenseTime, making him one of the earliest practitioners of large-scale pre-training in China.  
As a rare master's graduate recruited through the "Genius Youth" program, Zhao Lichen joined Huawei in 2023 and built a team of over 20 people from scratch. He won second place in the Huawei Algorithm Competition and led the continuous iteration of the AI Smart Home Agent's end-cloud architecture. The related project won the China Telecom Excellence Innovation Award and is set for mass production in the second half of 2026.  
With his outstanding technical and delivery capabilities, Zhao Lichen entered the Level 19 promotion track within just over two years, becoming one of Huawei's youngest senior technical executives.

Sus trabajos relacionados acumulan más de mil citas, y es el único estudiante de Beihang seleccionado hasta ahora para el programa de prodigios de Huawei.

excerpt_i18n.en: April 22, 2026 — SenseTime’s SenseAuto officially released Sage, an end-side multimodal agent base model. Sage adopts a MoE architecture with 32B total parameters and only 3B activated parameters, making it the industry’s first base model to achieve complex agent capabilities on the vehicle side. It leads global cloud-based models on PinchBench and has been deployed on NVIDIA Orin X edge platforms. AI has fully entered the agent era, but vehicle-side complex agent capabilities have relied on the cloud, while edge models, limited by computing power and parameters, could only handle simple command responses. Smart cockpits faced a dilemma: relying on the cloud introduced latency and high token costs, while sticking to the edge lacked true agent capabilities. Sage breaks this pattern, bringing cloud-level agent capabilities to the edge for the first time. As an edge agent base, Sage can integrate with mainstream agent frameworks like OpenClaw and Hermes, providing core support for more edge agent deployments across scenarios such as mobility and home. Sage’s strength has been validated in international public benchmarks. On the public agent benchmark PinchBench, Sage achieved a best task completion rate of 94%, surpassing Claude-Opus-4.6 (93.3%), Claude-Sonnet-4.6 (88.0%), and GPT-5.4 (90%).

Es el primer modelo base de la industria en lograr capacidades complejas de agente en el vehículo, con un rendimiento líder en PinchBench frente a los modelos en la nube globales de primer nivel, y ya se ha implementado en la plataforma de extremo NVIDIA Orin X. La IA ha entrado por completo en la era de los agentes, pero las capacidades complejas de agente en los vehículos dependen de la nube, mientras que los modelos en el extremo, limitados por la potencia de cálculo y los parámetros, solo pueden responder a instrucciones simples. El habitáculo inteligente se encuentra así en un dilema.

excerpt_i18n.en:
Since Tesla integrated Grok into its cabin and synergized it with FSD in July 2025, AI in vehicles has become an overnight sensation. However, behind the buzz, current progress largely remains at the level of "voice interaction upgrades," with no fundamental change in human-vehicle interaction paradigms. A truly "embodied intelligent agent" capable of understanding and executing intentions has yet to emerge. The industry is waiting for a product that can genuinely change the status quo.

On April 17, the Zeekr 8X launched, with pre-orders exceeding 10,000 units within 29 minutes. It debuted the "Super EVA," a vehicle-wide intelligent agent jointly developed by Step, Geely, and Qianli Technology. This product responds to the industry's long-standing anticipation.

Unlike previous AI systems confined to the cabin, Super EVA is defined as a "vehicle-wide intelligent agent," attempting to integrate the entire chain from perception and understanding to execution, extending AI capabilities from a "dialogue interface" to the system level.

Over the past year, discussions around "Grok + FSD" have been frequent, but most remain at the stage of chasing trends. With the mass production of Super EVA, this direction now has its first tangible implementation.

The watershed for large models in vehicles lies not in dialogue upgrades but in task execution. Currently, so-called "large models in vehicles" essentially involve integrating general-purpose models like Grok into the cabin to enhance voice interaction experiences. This integration is often referred to as "add-on" AI, which improves conversational interaction but cannot penetrate planning and control layers, falling far short of the truly vehicle-wide intelligent agent experience users expect.

Although "add-on" AI has achieved more natural conversations...
excerpt_i18n.es: Desde que Tesla integró Grok en la cabina y lo sincronizó con FSD en julio de 2025, la incorporación de la IA en los vehículos se convirtió de la noche a la mañana en una tendencia. Sin embargo, detrás del entusiasmo, los avances actuales se limitan principalmente a una mejora en la interacción por voz, sin un cambio fundamental en el paradigma de interacción entre humanos y vehículos. Aún no ha surgido un agente inteligente encarnado con capacidad real de comprensión y ejecución de intenciones. La industria está esperando un producto que realmente transforme la situación. El 17 de abril, el Zeekr 8X salió al mercado, alcanzando más de 10.000 pedidos en 29 minutos. Fue el primer modelo en incorporar el agente inteligente integral Super EVA, desarrollado conjuntamente por Step, Geely y Qianli Technology. Este producto responde a las expectativas acumuladas durante mucho tiempo en el sector. A diferencia de las soluciones anteriores limitadas a la cabina.

items.title: 中山大学郭裕兰团队：数据充足却训练失败，多智能体到底卡在哪丨CVPR 2026
items.raw_excerpt: 很多人其实已经在不知不觉中接触到了多智能体协作带来的变化。 电商大促时，仓库里往往不是一台机器人在工作，而是一整组机器人同时分拣、运输、避让和交接。自动驾驶真正困难的地方，也不只是让一辆车学会开，而是让很多辆车在同一条路上彼此配合。现实中的很多复杂任务，本质上都不是单个智能体可以独立完成的，智能系统也是一样。 但现实世界并不会给这些系统太多试错机会。仓库机器人撞一次货架，工业机械臂装错一次零件，代价都是真实的。也正因为如此，越来越多研究开始转向离线强化学习，也就是先利用已有数据训练策略，而不是依赖实时试错。 可一旦从单智能体走向多智能体，难度会迅速上升，因为系统不仅要学会做决策，还要在反馈有限的条件下学会协作。 这正是当前行业里的一个现实瓶颈。很多方法在实验环境里效果不错，但到了离线多智能体场景中，往往很快暴露出问题。 一方面，真实任务里的奖励通常非常稀疏，模型很难知道自己到底哪一步做对了。另一方面，多智能体协作还会带来责任分配问题，也就是最后成功了，却很难判断到底是哪一个智能体起了关键作用。结果就是，系统明明有大量历史数据，却依然学不会稳定协作，更谈不上面对新任务时的泛化能力。 在这样的背景下，来自中山大学的郭裕兰团队提出了 MangoBench，并在研究《MangoBench A Benchmark for Multi-Agent Goal-Conditioned Offline Reinforcement Learning》中，尝试重新回答一个关键问题，也就是当多个智能体不能随便试错时，怎样才能真正学会协作。 研究团队没有继续依赖传统奖励驱动，而是把问题改写成目标驱动，让模型围绕应该到达什么状态去学习，从而为离线多智能体强化学习提供了一条更清晰的研究路径。 论文地址：https://wendyeewang.github.io/MangoBench/ 性能分化的关键拐点

excerpt_i18n.en: Many people have already encountered the changes brought by multi-agent collaboration without even realizing it. During major e-commerce promotions, it's often not just one robot working in the warehouse, but an entire group of robots simultaneously sorting, transporting, avoiding obstacles, and handing off tasks. The real challenge in autonomous driving isn't just teaching a single vehicle to drive, but enabling many vehicles to coordinate with each other on the same road. In reality, many complex tasks cannot be completed independently by a single agent, and the same applies to intelligent systems. However, the real world doesn't offer these systems many opportunities for trial and error. A warehouse robot colliding with a shelf or an industrial robotic arm installing a part incorrectly comes with real costs. Precisely because of this, more and more research is shifting toward offline reinforcement learning, which involves training strategies using existing data rather than relying on real-time trial and error. Yet, moving from a single agent to multiple agents rapidly increases the difficulty, as the system must not only learn to make decisions but also learn to collaborate under conditions of limited feedback. This is a real bottleneck in the industry today. Many methods perform well in experimental environments but quickly reveal issues in offline multi-agent scenarios. On one hand, rewards in real-world tasks are often very sparse, making it difficult for models to know exactly which step was correct. On the other hand, multi-agent collaboration introduces the problem of responsibility allocation—even when success is achieved, it's hard to determine which agent played the key role. As a result, despite having vast amounts of historical data, systems still struggle to learn stable collaboration, let alone generalize to new tasks.

items.raw_excerpt: 很多人第一次觉得图像生成模型已经足够强，往往是在它能快速画出一张看上去不错的图的时候。但真正开始频繁使用之后，又会慢慢发现另一面。 比如做一张活动主视觉，前几次生成里主体、色调、氛围都对了，可一放大细节就会发现手部、材质、边缘关系经不起看。再比如给一篇文章配封面，模型明明理解了主题，却总在最后呈现时把重点元素放错位置，或者让画面风格和语义之间出现轻微但难以忽视的偏差。 这正是当前生成式 AI 进入大规模应用之后，行业越来越在意的一类问题。今天的 diffusion 模型已经不缺生成能力，缺的是更稳定、更可控、也更符合真实使用过程的生成机制。 过去几年，行业主要依靠更大的模型、更多的数据和更强的算力推动效果上升，但当模型能力不断逼近高位之后，很多问题开始不再表现为能不能生成，而是能不能稳定地生成对。换句话说，竞争的重点正在从模型会不会画，转向模型能不能在每一步都朝着正确方向画。 这个变化非常关键，因为它意味着生成模型的发展正在从规模驱动走向机制驱动。 在这个背景下，来自上海交通大学与 vivo BlueImage Lab 的研究团队提出了《C²FG Control Classifier Free Guidance via Score Discrepancy Analysis》。研究切中的恰恰是行业正在遇到的那个深层矛盾。 过去广泛使用的 guidance 方式，本质上默认生成过程中的条件引导强度可以保持固定，但真实的 diffusion 过程并不是静止的，模型在不同阶段对条件信息的依赖程度并不一样。研究人员抓住的，正是这种长期存在却常被经验调参掩盖的问题。 从这个意义上看，C²FG 代表的不只是一次技术修补，而是一种研究视角的变化。它提醒行业，下一阶段真正重要的问题，可能不再只是把模型做得更大，而是更精确地理解生成过程内部到底发生了什么，并据此重新设计控制方式。 论文地址：h

Many people first feel that image generation models are sufficiently powerful when they can quickly produce a decent-looking image. However, after frequent use, another side gradually emerges. For instance, when creating a main visual for an event, the subject, color tone, and atmosphere may be correct in the first few generations, but upon zooming in on details, issues with hands, textures, or edge relationships become apparent. Similarly, when generating a cover for an article, the model may understand the theme but often misplaces key elements in the final output or introduces subtle yet noticeable discrepancies between the visual style and semantics.  

This is precisely the type of issue the industry is increasingly concerned about as generative AI enters large-scale application. Today’s diffusion models do not lack generative capability but rather a more stable, controllable, and realistic generation mechanism aligned with practical usage.  

In recent years, the industry has primarily relied on larger models, more data, and greater computing power to improve results. Sin embargo, tras comenzar a usarlos con frecuencia, gradualmente se descubre otra faceta. Por ejemplo, al diseñar un cartel principal para un evento, las primeras generaciones pueden acertar en el sujeto, la paleta de colores y la atmósfera, pero al ampliar los detalles, se nota que las manos, las texturas y los bordes no resisten un examen minucioso. excerpt_i18n.en:
Many people encounter similar situations when using text-to-image tools: they input a clear description, hoping for a character on the left and an animal on the right, or expecting a complete, readable text on a poster, but the generated results often disappoint. Either the positional relationships are confused, the text is distorted, or the overall image appears unnatural. Adjusting parameters may sometimes bring the result closer to the description, but the image quality noticeably declines, with colors turning strange and structures beginning to warp. After repeated attempts, it often takes generating dozens or even hundreds of images to barely select one that is usable. This contradictory experience of wanting the model to understand instructions without compromising image quality has become a common feeling among many users in practical applications of generative models.

As generative AI gradually enters real-world scenarios like design, e-commerce, and content creation, this issue has become more prominent. Users no longer just seek a visually appealing image but desire stable results with correct structures and reliable details that can be directly applied to practical work. However, existing methods consistently show a clear conflict between controllability and stability: the more the model emphasizes semantic alignment, the more it tends to sacrifice visual quality. This inherent limitation is increasingly becoming a barrier to the broader application of generative models.

Against this backdrop, the team led by Duan Yueqi at Tsinghua University proposed the research work "CFG-Ctrl: Control-Based Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance," addressing the issue from a more fundamental level.
